lines.text: Edit one row of history. Watch it get caught.
Seventeen events in the chain — every one hash-linked to the last. Signed by a key only we hold.
Now the edit. One statement. One principal, changed — alice becomes mallory.
Nothing complains. The record looks perfectly normal. No alarm — not yet.
But verification re-walks every hash. Entry three doesn't match anymore.
Entry three: hash mismatch — event modified, or entries removed. Named. Located. Undeniable. One edit, one hash, caught — in under a second.
